messages:
Maya (PM): Quick thread — we need to finalize prod certification for the 'Optimize' roadmap item so we can schedule GA next Tues. Specifically: SLA targets, docs, oncall, monitoring alerts, pricing page. Owners: SLA/Omar, Docs/Jules, Oncall/Priya, Pricing/Sara. Can each confirm status?
Omar (Eng): SLA draft posted in the doc, proposing 99.9% availability and p95 latency <= 150ms for hosted small models. Question on dedicated tier SLOs — do we set separate latency buckets?
Priya (SRE): Oncall rota updated. We need runbooks for cache cold-start incident and model fallback. I'll add the templates to the runbooks repo tonight.
Jules (Docs): Draft user-facing upgrade notes + API changes are 75% done. Need final callouts on breaking behavior for kv-cache headers. ETA EOD Monday.
Sara (Sales): Pricing page PR ready but awaiting final numbers from FinOps; also want a short FAQ for enterprise customers re: dedicated capacity SLAs.
Maya (PM): Thanks — Omar can you confirm if 99.9% should be global or region-specific? If region-specific, list regions we cover at GA.
Omar (Eng): Let's make it region-specific: GA regions = us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1. 99.9% per-region for hosted. Dedicated customers get contractual SLA negotiated.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed. I'll map alerts to those regions in the monitor playbook. Also asking: do we have synthetic checks for streaming endpoints?
Omar (Eng): Yes — synthetic for streaming + generation path exists; I'll share dashboards and thresholds: error rate > 0.5% or p95 spikes > 200ms trigger P1.
Jules (Docs): For runbooks I need the exact alert names and P1/P2 definitions to link. Omar/Priya please drop them here or in the doc.
Sara (Sales): For enterprise FAQ, I need copy on incident response time and escalation path. Priya can you provide oncall SLA steps?
Priya (SRE): Short version: P1 -> page + phone + incident bridge within 15 min; P2 -> page + email within 60 min. I'll paste a brief blurb now.
Priya (SRE): "P1 — immediate bridge, engineer assigned within 15 minutes; Customer updates every 30 minutes until mitigation. P2 — respond within 60 minutes; updates every 2 hours."
Maya (PM): Good. Two open items: legal review of SLA language (Legal + Contracts) and analytics instrumentation for billing metrics. Who owns billing metrics?
Sara (Sales): FinOps owns final rates but I'll coordinate the billing metrics with Eng. Omar, can you expose token-level counters per route by GA?
Omar (Eng): Yes, token counters per route and per-model will be in the GA metric set. Exposing to billing pipeline needs an auth gateway; will file a small infra ticket.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy "optimize/ga-review" started by Maya at 1746123475.
Maya (PM): Okay team: let's aim for final signoffs by EOD Monday. If you can't meet that, reply with blockers now. I'll compile a handoff doc for Ops and Legal. :thumbsup:
